## Publication gate

The Weakness family passes only when:

- all thirteen stable IDs remain available to existing presets and content packs;
- every Weakness exposes a telegraphed procedure, a concrete exploit, a bounded payoff, and a recovery or immunity window where needed;
- no arbitrary called-shot penalties, unreachable damage thresholds, undefined checks, or cross-graft dependencies remain;
- telegraphs such as Brood Tell are converted into an actual interactable weakness rather than descriptive copy alone;
- CR scaling changes thresholds or payoff only where encounter math requires it;
- all CR projections compile with verified renderer parity.
